fullContentHtml:
NTPC Assistant Chemist Trainee Online Form 2026 – Full Details

National Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC) has released the notification for the post of Assistant Chemist Trainee. This recruitment has been issued for 40 posts. The online application process for NTPC Assistant Chemist Trainee Recruitment 2026 has started on 26 June 2026, and candidates can apply till 10 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NTPC Assistant Chemist Trainee Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 26 June 2026
  • Last Date : 10 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 July 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification (English)
  • Download Notification (Hindi)
  • Official Website
